primary: reference term hit-to-miss newly introduced misses
gained/lost false-term mentions anchored to fixed edit alignment
secondary: micro MER, paired clip edit changes
term_matching: unchanged nfkc_han_latin_digits_v1; longest nonoverlapping complete term; fixed minimum-edit alignment; no aliases, compound merging, translation or number merging

uncertainty.method: paired clip percentile bootstrap stratified by language; retain each language count

analysis_start_gate: all 2175 predictions, 725 unique complete pairs, run.status complete, frozen inputs/audio/source hashes and saved scores verified; no interim treatment-effect analysis

cohorts.development: old200 retained separately; previous24 is nested, not extra evidence
cohorts.replication: all725 remaining eligible validation clips; no lexical selection
cohorts.pooled925: supplemental descriptive aggregate including development clips; not independent validation

interpretation: Term corrections, new misses and false mentions lead the report; MER reduction alone is insufficient evidence of term benefit.
No positive/negative result triggers extra samples or changes to vocabulary, prompt, normalization, reference or configuration.
Zero bootstrap variation for unchanged term states is not evidence of equivalence.
Within-cohort paired arm comparisons are primary; cross-cohort absolute MER differences are not glossary effects.
No generalization to personal jargon, speakers independent of development, official test benchmark, Ubuntu or GPU speed.
failure_policy: Stop on runtime errors, keep partial output and stdout/stderr; do not score incomplete predictions or silently restart/overwrite. Any retry gets a new run ID, records cause and retains frozen protocol; no selective retries.
